name: cross_surface_snooker
description: SC-001 gate scenario with a NON-DEFAULT ball radius (52.5 mm snooker-size, r = 0.02625): the '"table": "wpa_9ft"' preset must expand with the FIRST ball's radius on EVERY surface (cushion nose height = 0.635 * 2r), so this scenario diverges byte-wise the moment any surface falls back to the default-radius table.
provenance: review finding on crates/pool-cli/src/scenario.rs expand_table_preset vs pool-wasm table_geometry_json / pool_py Table.wpa_9ft default radii; ball mass 0.142 kg (snooker spec), other params kernel defaults scaled to r
